learning_order:
**Solo default: Retribution (Seal of Righteousness / Seal of Command, Judgement, Holy Strike). Protection is a durable alternative.**

- **1-10:** Devotion Aura, Blessing of Might, Judgement, Holy Strike (6), Divine Protection, Holy Light, Hammer of Justice, Purify, Parry. Core loop: seal, Judgement, Holy Strike on cooldown.
- **10:** Seal of Righteousness rank 2, Blessing of Protection, Lay on Hands. Seal of Fury and Righteous Fury only for tanking.
- **12-18:** Redemption rank 1 comes from the class quest. Holy Strike, Holy Light, SoR ranks yes. Retribution Aura at 16 is your main aura. Seal of the Crusader ranks can be skipped.
- **20:** Blessing of Kings and Consecration (baseline now). Exorcism and Flash of Light are optional (Flash is core for healers).
- **22-28:** Skip Concentration Aura, Seal of Justice, Turn Undead, Shadow Resistance Aura. Hammer of Justice 2 and Holy Light 4 yes.
- **30:** Lay on Hands 2, Holy Light 5. Seal of Command rank 2 if talented (cheap). Seal of Light optional. Skip Divine Intervention.
- **34:** Divine Shield. Keep Seal of Righteousness/Holy Strike/Retribution Aura current.
- **38-44:** Seal of Wisdom optional. Plate Mail at 40. Cleanse at 42 (optional solo, core for healers). Hammer of Wrath at 44 is a good execute.
- **46-60:** Keep Holy Strike, SoR, Holy Light, Blessing of Might and Retribution Aura current. Skip resistance auras, Blessing of Sacrifice and Greater Blessings while leveling.
- Talent ranks (Seal of Command, Holy Shock, Holy Shield, Light's Vigil) are very cheap; buy them if talented.

**Money tips**
- Safe skips: all Resistance Auras, Turn Undead, Divine Intervention, Seal of Justice, Concentration Aura, Greater Blessings.
- Higher Redemption, Divine Protection and Blessing of Protection ranks mainly add duration or resurrect health.
- Devotion Aura ranks only matter if you use it instead of Retribution Aura (e.g. tanking).
- The level 40 mount is free (Method.gg); dual spec costs 50g at 40.
- Consecration drains mana quickly while soloing (Method.gg); upgrade only if you AoE or tank.
disagreements: Blessing choice: Warcraft Tavern Classic prefers Blessing of Wisdom over Might (less drinking); Forever guides (Warcraft Tavern, Method.gg) say choose by spec, with Might/Kings for melee.
Aura: Warcraft Tavern Classic buys every Devotion Aura rank; Warcraft Tavern Forever names Retribution Aura the main leveling aura.
Consecration: Warcraft Tavern Forever uses it on cooldown for Protection/Shockadin; Method.gg says use it conservatively in open world because of mana.
Instrument of the Law: Warcraft Tavern's summary says it makes Holy Wrath instant; Blizzard's post (as fetched) says it reduces Hammer of Wrath cast time.
forever_differences: Holy Strike is a baseline instant attack learned at 6 (Blizzard deep dive).
Judgement no longer consumes the seal (Blizzard deep dive) and is off the GCD (Method.gg).
Seal of Fury is a new tank seal at 10; its Judgement taunts from 10 yards (Blizzard deep dive).
Consecration (20) and Blessing of Kings (20) are baseline; Improved Blessing of Wisdom baseline (Blizzard deep dive).
Lay on Hands cooldown 20 min, was 60 (Blizzard deep dive).
Holy Shock moved to 21-point talent with 10 s cooldown; new Light's Vigil 31-point talent (Blizzard deep dive).
Sanctity Aura and Blessing of Sanctuary removed; resistance auras affect the whole raid within 30 yd (Blizzard deep dive).
Salvation is no longer a Blessing (Mass Salvation); not on the trainer list (Blizzard deep dive).
Spell power scales Retribution Aura and seal Holy damage (Warcraft Tavern Forever).
Holy Light rank 1 and Seal of Righteousness rank 1 are not on the trainer list (starting spells); Redemption rank 1 from class quest (Warcraft Tavern Forever).
open_questions: Whether Exorcism and Holy Wrath are still restricted to undead/demons in Forever is not stated in the sources read; advice kept 'optional'.
Seal of Command, Seal of Light, Seal of Wisdom, Seal of Justice, Turn Undead and Greater Blessings are not covered by the Blizzard post; Classic behavior assumed.
No Forever guide read gives rank-by-rank skip advice; rank skips follow Classic guidance.
